_note: The Sparxie skin is public (owner, 2026-10-03: 「Sparxieのスキンに関してはパスワード不要で大丈夫です。一般公開されます。」). The portal puts it on the 3D model for everyone and downloads it without a PIN. The file is the in-game texture shipped in alpha-planarcadia-4.4.0.1 (assets/sorakaze_planarcadia/textures/entity/sparxie.png), byte-identical to the plaintext the sealed blob carries (data/skin_gate.json plain_sha256), so the PIN was never needed to publish it. The sealed blob stays for the record; nothing reads it while this file exists.
